title: Behind the Curtain — Named Access and Intermediary Registry
editorialBoundary: This registry maps current public roles, documented access mechanisms and clearly labelled analytical assessments. It does not infer criminality, occult allegiance or unified secret command from wealth, office, family, philanthropy, membership, attendance or social contact.

publicationLanes.documented_fact: Current role or enforceable authority supported by an authoritative source.
publicationLanes.strongly_supported_assessment: Documented role plus a transparent structural assessment of access.
publicationLanes.plausible_structural_inference: A bounded inference from repeated institutional connections; not proof of command.
publicationLanes.speculative_hypothesis: A theory presented for testing with evidence for, evidence against and required proof.
